title: Challenge 4 Quiz - RWA Markets and Use Cases

questions.question: Which sector is considered one of the largest applications of Real-World Asset tokenization?
What is one major benefit of tokenized real estate?
Which of the following is an example of a commodity that can be tokenized?
Why are custodians important in commodity-backed tokenization projects?
options: They securely safeguard the underlying physical assets.

questions.question: Which financial asset can be tokenized?
What is one risk associated with tokenized debt investments?
Which of the following is considered intellectual property?
In many intellectual property tokenization projects, tokens commonly represent:
Which statement about tokenization is correct?
options: Blockchain records digital ownership while legal rights remain governed by applicable laws.

questions.question: What should investors always do before participating in an RWA project?
options: Perform due diligence by reviewing the asset, legal structure and associated risks.
